messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: Re: latest clang++ for Mac?
parts:
3.1 is just "trunk". They don't even have a release calendar for it
yet, much less a beta. Jiqiang had some segfault with trunk that I
didn't encounter with 3.0. So, I would say to use 3.0. Otherwise, the
next time something weird happens, it will be "check to see if it
still happens on 3.0".

Ben

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] latest clang++ for Mac?
parts:
Sorry -- should have been clearer. Type into a terminal window:
sudo port install clang-3.0

After typing your password, it should attempt to download a bunch of
stuff. I'm downloading clang-3.0 now. I'll let you know if it's
successful in a little bit.


Daniel
